title: A map fixing N to first order fixes the orientation of an integer multiplicity triple carried by N
statement: Let P, n, d ∈ ℕ, N ⊆ ℝ^P an embedded C¹ d-dimensional submanifold (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 d N), O ⊆ ℝ^P a Borel set, U ⊆ ℝ^P, R = (M, θ, ξ) an integer multiplicity triple in U (IMRep U n) with Hⁿ(M ∖ N) = 0 (Hⁿ = μHE[n]), and f : ℝ^P → ℝ^P such that f(x) = x and Df(x)v = v for every x ∈ N ∩ O and every v ∈ T_xN (tangentSpace N x; Df(x) = fderiv ℝ f x). Then for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M ∩ O (i.e. Hⁿ⌞(M ∩ O)-a.e.): f(x) = x and ξ(x)(α∘Df(x)) = ξ(x)(α) for every n-covector α (α∘L = α.compContinuousLinearMap L).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n d : ℕ) (U N O : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (f : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 d N → MeasurableSet O → μHE[n] (R.carrier \ N) = 0 → (∀ x ∈ N ∩ O, f x = x) → (∀ x ∈ N ∩ O, ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace N x, fderiv ℝ f x v = v) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (R.carrier ∩ O)), f x = x ∧ ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, R.orient x (α.compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)) = R.orient x α
